model: Tracer UC600 Packaged Outdoor Air Unit
applies_to: Trane packaged outdoor air units controlled by a Tracer UC600 running the packaged outdoor air unit program.
summary: The Tracer UC600 is a programmable B-AAC controller; on packaged outdoor air units it runs a Trane program exposing about 175 objects with short instances (AI 1, AV 20, BV 16...). The BMS commands occupancy with MV 1 and writes '... BAS' values for sensors and setpoints, which ship Out of Service and must be put In Service first. Which objects are used depends on the unit type and options (space, discharge or VAV control, heat pump, gas heat, ERV).
notes: The guide has no read/write column. Access is inferred: inputs, hardware outputs, Active/Status values and diagnostics are read-only; setpoints, '... BAS' values, configuration values, Alarm Reset and Occupancy Request are writable.

Each object is printed twice in the guide (by type in Tables 3-9 and by name in Table 10); names here come from the by-type tables. Table 10 calls AV 50 'Space CO2 Concentration Setpoint' and BV 43 'Ventilation Mode'.
'When the point exists' conditions are shown in brackets where they fit; points marked 'All Units' have no bracket.
BI 1 Supply Fan Status is printed with inverted states (0 = On, 1 = Off).
The UC600 hardware also has an Ethernet port, but this guide covers BACnet MS/TP only.

source.title: Integration Guide: Tracer UC600 Programmable Controller, Packaged Outdoor Air Unit

integration.summary: Command occupancy with MV 1 Occupancy Request and send setpoints (AV 25 space setpoint, AV 30/AV 32 discharge setpoints, AV 67 on multizone VAV). If the BMS supplies sensor values, put the '... BAS' objects In Service and keep refreshing them. Read MV 2, BI 1, AV 5 and the diagnostic BVs; clear latching lockouts with BV 16 Alarm Reset.

minimum_points.name: Space Temperature Setpoint BAS
minimum_points.why: Space setpoint (space control / single zone VAV)

minimum_points.name: Alarm Reset
minimum_points.why: 1 = reset diagnostics and lockouts; return to 0 after

minimum_points.name: System LOCKOUT
minimum_points.why: Unit locked out; needs Alarm Reset

integration.enable: No enable point is described. The BAS controls the unit by writing values and putting points In or Out of Service. MV 1 Occupancy Request sets occupancy.
integration.heartbeat: The guide says the BAS must routinely refresh BAS-supplied sensor values to protect against a communication loss, but gives no timeout value.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature BAS (AV 20), Space RH BAS (AV 8), Outdoor Air Temperature BAS (AV 75), Outdoor Air Humidity BAS (AV 81) and Discharge Air Temperature BAS (AV 4) are Out of Service from the factory; put them In Service to use them and keep rewriting them. The matching '... Active' AVs show the value in use.
setup: Three rotary switches set the MS/TP MAC address (1-127; 0 is reserved for a Tracer SC) and, by default, the Device ID.
For a Device ID above 127, enable 'Use Software Device ID' in Tracer TU or the BACnet Setup Tool, then cycle power.
MS/TP baud rates 9600, 19200, 38400 and 76800 (default 76800); set with Tracer TU or the BACnet Setup Tool along with the communicated units, then cycle power.
The controller is BTL listed as a B-AAC and supports COV, alarm summary and trend retrieval.
gotchas: BV 16 Alarm Reset resets ALL diagnostics and lockouts; the BMS must set it back to inactive afterwards.
Latching diagnostics (supply fan failure, OAD proving, temperature lockouts, System LOCKOUT) stay active until reset.
BAS sensor objects are ignored while Out of Service (the factory default).
